hook.name: HookeMemeHook
hook.description: A single-hook meme launchpad managing bonding curves for meme tokens paired with hXMAX. Each swap pays a 1% fee on the hXMAX leg via BeforeSwapDelta/AfterSwapReturnsDelta, split between a per-launch fee recipient and the treasury; external liquidity is blocked until the curve empties, at which point remaining assets are permanently locked in a dead-address v4 position.
